records.text: Robert Kolvet, Andrew Kolvet's cousin, commanded the 485th Military Police Company in Afghanistan at the same time Curtis Kolvet was deployed there.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And just like the Facebook caption is going to say, he wasn't the only Colbert that was there. He was also serving with his first cousin, Robert Kolvet. ... That's Andrew's cousin. The exact same time, Robert Kolvet was the commander of the 485th military police.

verification.notes: A Nevada National Guard publication identifies 1st Lt. Robert Kolvet as commander of the 485th Military Police Company in Afghanistan during the relevant period. The asserted cousin relationship to Andrew Kolvet was not independently documented.

records.text: May the Kolvets, the Frantzves, and the Bowyers all have run into each other in Romania?
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Yeah, Erika, you know, there is just so much synergy building, right? I find myself wondering if the Kolvets and the Frantzves and the Boyers. ... May have all run into each other in Romania. Is that a crazy question to ask while we're transporting through Romania?

verification.notes: This is posed as speculation about whether several families may have encountered one another. Accessible military, charity, and biographical sources do not document such an encounter, and absence of a public record cannot prove it did not occur.
